mapper.insert: INSERT INTO packing_item (name, category, quantity, notes, is_packed, source, trip_id) VALUES (#{name}, #{category}, #{quantity}, #{notes}, #{isPacked}, #{source}, #{trip.id})
mapper.select: SELECT pi.*, t.id as trip_id FROM packing_item pi LEFT JOIN trip t ON pi.trip_id = t.id WHERE pi.id = #{id}
SELECT pi.*, t.id as trip_id FROM packing_item pi LEFT JOIN trip t ON pi.trip_id = t.id WHERE pi.trip_id = #{tripId}
SELECT pi.*, t.id as trip_id FROM packing_item pi LEFT JOIN trip t ON pi.trip_id = t.id WHERE pi.trip_id = #{tripId} AND pi.is_packed = #{isPacked}
SELECT pi.*, t.id as trip_id FROM packing_item pi LEFT JOIN trip t ON pi.trip_id = t.id WHERE pi.trip_id = #{tripId} AND pi.category = #{category}
SELECT pi.*, t.id as trip_id FROM packing_item pi LEFT JOIN trip t ON pi.trip_id = t.id
mapper.update: UPDATE packing_item SET name = #{name}, category = #{category}, quantity = #{quantity}, notes = #{notes}, is_packed = #{isPacked}, source = #{source}, trip_id = #{trip.id} WHERE id = #{id}
